role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
promise: Deliver a 10-year plan for Britain to end a decade of instability
description: Andy Burnham became UK prime minister on 20 July 2026, pledging to end a decade of political instability and to set out a 10-year plan for Britain. A ten-year horizon from taking office is used as the calculable due date.
evidence: Burnham became PM vowing a 10-year plan for Britain (BSS News)
CNN reported Burnham pledged to end instability after becoming the UK's seventh prime minister in a decade
